name: kb-whisper-medium
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from openai/whisper-medium (config.json max_position_embeddings 1500). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-25. A finetune of openai/whisper-medium, not a new base model: same config.json, same 0.817 parameters . Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2025-02-14. Caveats: same shared family WER table; the OpenAI column here is whisper-medium, the same-size base. Swedish only. Direct comparison to kb-whisper-small in the same table shows the medium is uniformly better (6.6/5.4/5.8 vs 7.3/6.4/6.6).
